readableTags.TITLE: Saturday repair café: the rain plan

meeting.title: Saturday repair café: the rain plan

turns.speaker: spk_maya_a95db5b0ac159e4384ff55ef
turns.label: Maya
turns.text: So, Saturday, I think we have to give up on the courtyard, the forecasts got worse. We can have the small hall, but the craft group are in there until until half past ten, and that's

turns.speaker: spk_tess_7134aac53eddcc48c4c90667
turns.label: Tess
turns.text: Right.

turns.speaker: spk_maya_a95db5b0ac159e4384ff55ef
turns.label: Maya
turns.text: when they finish, not when the room's clear.

turns.speaker: spk_jonah_b2d60d92ca43aa51a0c91ba9
turns.label: Jonah
turns.text: Then 11's the earliest. We need to get the tables in, run the cables. I'd rather not have people waiting around us while we do that.

turns.speaker: spk_tess_7134aac53eddcc48c4c90667
turns.label: Tess
turns.text: Hang on, let me check who's booked before 11. Three. Two bikes and a toaster. Are we taking bikes inside?

turns.speaker: spk_maya_a95db5b0ac159e4384ff55ef
turns.label: Maya
turns.text: Could they go under the awning?

turns.speaker: spk_jonah_b2d60d92ca43aa51a0c91ba9
turns.label: Jonah
turns.text: With the repair stands there, we'd be blocking the doorway, and

turns.speaker: spk_maya_a95db5b0ac159e4384ff55ef
turns.label: Maya
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.speaker: spk_jonah_b2d60d92ca43aa51a0c91ba9
turns.label: Jonah
turns.text: rain comes in sideways under that thing. I think we have to cancel the bikes this time.

turns.speaker: spk_tess_7134aac53eddcc48c4c90667
turns.label: Tess
turns.text: Okay, I'll ring those two then. I don't want them cycling over in the rain for nothing. Next month's session or do we know somewhere sooner?

turns.speaker: spk_jonah_b2d60d92ca43aa51a0c91ba9
turns.label: Jonah
turns.text: There's the bike workshop at the library next weekend. I'll check they've got spaces before we send anyone there.

turns.speaker: spk_tess_7134aac53eddcc48c4c90667
turns.label: Tess
turns.text: Thanks. And I've got eleven fifteen free for

turns.speaker: spk_jonah_b2d60d92ca43aa51a0c91ba9
turns.label: Jonah
turns.text: Mm-hmm.

turns.speaker: spk_tess_7134aac53eddcc48c4c90667
turns.label: Tess
turns.text: the toaster if that suits them. Everything after 11 can stay as it is.

turns.speaker: spk_maya_a95db5b0ac159e4384ff55ef
turns.label: Maya
turns.text: How many tables can we actually fit?

turns.speaker: spk_jonah_b2d60d92ca43aa51a0c91ba9
turns.label: Jonah
turns.text: four comfortably, two for electrical repairs, one for sewing, one for intake. No spare table for people to leave things on.

turns.speaker: spk_tess_7134aac53eddcc48c4c90667
turns.label: Tess
turns.text: That's fine. I'll keep the waiting list at the desk. People need to stay with their stuff anyway.

turns.speaker: spk_maya_a95db5b0ac159e4384ff55ef
turns.label: Maya
turns.text: I'll update the website and the neighborhood group tonight. And put a sign on the courtyard gate. Actually I'll be there from ten until we open, because

turns.speaker: spk_tess_7134aac53eddcc48c4c90667
turns.label: Tess
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: spk_maya_a95db5b0ac159e4384ff55ef
turns.label: Maya
turns.text: someone will have seen the old time.

turns.speaker: spk_jonah_b2d60d92ca43aa51a0c91ba9
turns.label: Jonah
turns.text: I'll tell the repair volunteers half 10 for setup. Still finishing at one?

turns.speaker: spk_maya_a95db5b0ac159e4384ff55ef
turns.label: Maya
turns.text: Yes, we can't keep everyone late.

turns.speaker: spk_tess_7134aac53eddcc48c4c90667
turns.label: Tess
turns.text: Last walk-ins at quarter past twelve then? We can have a look, but I won't promise we'll fix it.

turns.speaker: spk_jonah_b2d60d92ca43aa51a0c91ba9
turns.label: Jonah
turns.text: Exactly, and we stop taking things earlier if the queue's full.

turns.speaker: spk_tess_7134aac53eddcc48c4c90667
turns.label: Tess
turns.text: Good. I'll make those three calls now.
